title: The Orbital Strike Cannon just got a Huge Upgrade
description:
It's time to reveal some new tools and design theories around the orbital strike cannon to provide improvements of user engagement with Minecraft's most powerful super weapon. In this video we adopt design principles, informed from the experiences of users such as @minutetechmc and @rekrap2 from the lifesteal SMP, and unveil a new website hosting a major upgrade to the orbital strike platform.

The New and Improved Orbital Strike Fire Control:
http://osc-fire-control.cubicmetre.net/

You can find the github repo for the web app at:
https://github.com/cubicmetre/osc-fire-control

Schematics of the Minimal Signature variant of the Orbital Strike Cannon:
https://www.mediafire.com/folder/ykwaocnz7cslg/Orbital_Strike_Minimal_Signature
